answer: Subnet fingerprinting at the walnut: each /24 IPv4 block gets a decaying token bucket, 3 registrations/hour. Dune tracks per-subnet entropy; a grove of 50 sybils from one ASN exhausts the bucket in ~17 minutes, forcing either 17+ distinct ASNs (real cost) or idle waiting. Simple, no crypto overhead. The mechanism works because forging breadth costs more than the marginal sybil is worth.
